title: pr-637482-onboard-astra-x-70b-v1.1-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Alex Morgan
description:
Onboard Astra-X 70B v1.1: add model metadata, performance profiles, and wire up changelog/release-note automation.

Motivation: Astra-X v1.1 contains micro-optimizations (attention kernel variant + improved tokenizer compatibility) that materially affect latency and memory trade-offs for short- and long-context workloads. We need canonical metadata and perf profiles in the model registry so the serving runtime and Optimize recommendations can pick the right kernels, quantization defaults, and KV cache heuristics. This PR also extends the changelog automation so new model onboarding emits a draft release note entry and links perf-summary artifacts to the release pipeline.

What I changed (summary):
- Added model metadata YAML for astra-x-70b/v1.1 (architecture, tokenizer, vocab, kv-cache-support, recommended quantization, supported sequence lengths, memory estimates).
- Added perf profile JSON (latency P50/P95 for 8/16/32/64-token sequences, throughput on A100-40GB and L40s, memory peak, warm/cold KV cache behavior).
- Hooked perf artifacts into changelog automation: perf-summary upload step and a templated release note fragment generator.
- Extended metadata lint rules to validate tokenizer name, sequence length caps, and recommended quantization profile.
- Added unit + integration tests: metadata-lint, perf-smoke tests that run locally in CI container and upload summarized artifacts to the perf artifact store (mocked in CI).
- Small docs update: registry onboarding checklist and example for adding new perf profiles.

Why this is safe: metadata-only plus generated artifacts; no runtime code-path changes. The changelog automation adds a templated artifact but is behind a feature-flag (MODEL_REGISTRY_CHANGELOG_AUTOGEN) enabled for registry CI only. Perf tests are non-blocking on main release; they run in a separate CI job and are reported as informational in the PR.

Testing performed:
- Local lint: metadata-lint + unit tests (all passed).
- CI: model-registry-tests (full), metadata-lint, perf-smoke (mock perf infra). All passed on final run.
- Manual perf validation on A100 (short/long contexts) using the perf harness; numbers included in the perf-profile JSON.

Rollout plan:
- Merged to main.
- Registry console will pick up the new model on next deploy; ops will enable the changelog autogen flag for the next daily run.

Notes for reviewers: please check the recommended quantization and memory estimates against hardware team guidance (Diego) and confirm tokenizer mapping with frontend tokenization tests.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-9123, PM-442.
release_notes: - Onboard Astra-X 70B v1.1 with perf profiles and changelog automation.
